DJGPP_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install djgpp. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

DJGPP_VERSION.description: Specific version of djgpp to install.

DJGPP_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading djgpp binary or archive artifacts.

DJGPP_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying djgpp available remote releases.

DJGPP_GCC_VERSION.description: GCC release series bundled inside the build-djgpp cross-compiler archive.

DJGPP_WITH_GUEST_BASH.description: Stage 32-bit DJGPP GNU BASH.EXE into target-dos/bin when set to 1.

DJGPP_WITH_GUEST_COREUTILS.description: Stage 32-bit DJGPP GNU coreutils into target-dos/bin when set to 1.

DJGPP_WITH_WATT32.description: Stage Watt-32 TCP/IP library headers and libwatt.a into the DJGPP sysroot when set to 1.

DJGPP_DOWNLOAD_PREBUILT.description: Download prebuilt andrewwutw/build-djgpp host cross-compiler archives when set to 1.
